cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: What Really Happened?
cards.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. We're claiming for your lost bag. At four, were you on the bus or buying coffee? You've told me both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Coffee. Can we finish the form?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Was the bag beside you when you paid?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. The driver waited while I ran in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So both fit. Tell me the boarding bit again: did the bag come back out with you?

mechanism: A withholds permission to finish the claim until seemingly incompatible details are reconciled and tested further.
confusable: Unlike suspicion for its own sake, A accepts that both accounts fit when B supplies the connecting detail.
comparison: A bus waiting during coffee purchase differs from the physical classification of a parcel.
seedUse: The seed already gives B a request to finish and A a reason to postpone approval while reconstructing the route.
